spec: The system a libretro core that declares no libretro database name is named by (#784 D46): one cited (source, key) pair per core, keyed by the .so short name, a hand judgement from a table source that spells the system. A bare RetroArch names its systems by the libretro database names its cores' .info files declare, and a core that declares none would otherwise be named by no key at all. 'systemname' is the core's own name for its system as the deployed .info states it (empty where it states none), held against the deployed cores by tests/test_core_systems_tripwire.py together with the absence of a database line, so an entry whose core gained a database or changed its name turns red. A core that is itself a game, a player or a tool rather than an emulator of a system, or that emulates one no table source spells, has no entry and is named under no system; the tripwire names each of them. Read by atlas.firmware.packaged_core_systems.
